nodes.description: Registry contract reference used to resolve avatars and cEther.
BComptroller used to map cToken to bToken.
BToken wrapping cETH, used to mint/redeem/borrow flash-loaned ETH on the avatar.
Permissionless import of a Compound account: flash-mints ETH on B, borrows debt on B, repays Compound, moves collateral, sweeps remaining ETH to msg.sender.
Permissionless transfer of a tx.origin account's collateral into its B avatar.
Repays Compound debt on behalf of the imported account, in ETH or ERC20.
Enters market and pulls the account's cToken collateral into the avatar.
Re-creates the Compound debt as a B debt on the avatar.
Payable fallback that accepts reimbursed ETH during the import flow.
tx.origin is used as the Compound account owner to be imported.
msg.sender is the caller, delegatee or recipient of swept ETH.
msg.sender.transfer(address(this).balance) sends the entire contract balance to the caller.
BEther(bETH).mintOnAvatar.value(ethBalance)(avatar) mints the whole contract ETH balance onto the avatar.
BEther(bETH).redeemUnderlyingOnAvatar(avatar, ethBalance) redeems ETH back from B.
BEther(bETH).borrowOnAvatar(avatar, shortfall) borrows against the avatar to close the flash loan.
Permissionless flash-loan-assisted import entrypoint with caller-supplied importer and flash provider.
Permissionless flash-loan import variant that repays the provider an extra hard-coded 1000 wei.
importer.transfer(ethAmountToFlashBorrow) pushes borrowed ETH to an arbitrary caller-supplied address.
FlashLoanLike(flash).borrow(ETH, amount, msg.data) re-enters the caller-supplied provider with the same calldata.
Creates the caller's avatar, temporarily delegates to a delegatee, executes an arbitrary external call with value, then revokes.
Returns (and lazily creates) the avatar of an owner address.
Deploys and initializes a new avatar proxy for an owner.
CREATE2 deployment of the GnosisSafeProxy avatar with a deterministic salt.
Grants a delegatee permission over the caller's avatar.
Mapping avatar => delegatee => bool, the core authorization state for BToken/BComptroller delegatee calls.
Mapping owner => avatar.
Mapping avatar => owner.
Implementation (logic) contract address used for avatar proxies.
Helper contract used to forward calls in delegateAndExecuteOnce.
Executes an arbitrary low-level call with msg.value on an arbitrary target.
target.call.value(msg.value)(data) forwards arbitrary calldata and ETH to a caller-chosen contract.
Deploys a BEther/BErc20 wrapper for a listed cToken and records the cToken/bToken mapping.
Mapping cToken => bToken used to resolve B tokens.
Registry reference used for delegate and avatar lookups.
The underlying Compound cToken this BToken wraps.
Modifier enforcing registry.delegate(_avatar, msg.sender) for on-avatar operations.
Pulls underlying from msg.sender into the avatar and mints the cToken position.
Forwards msg.value as ETH mint on the caller's avatar.
IAvatarCEther(_avatar).mint.value(msg.value)() forwards ETH to the avatar/Compound.
Fallback that delegatecalls the master copy for every call.
delegatecall(gas, masterCopy, ...) gives the implementation full control over proxy storage.
Implementation slot read directly from storage slot 0 in the proxy.
Owner address controlling privileged Registry functions.
onlyOwner transfer of the Registry ownership.
ICEther/ICErc20 repayBorrowBehalf and safeApprove external calls repaying Compound debt.
IAvatar(avatar).collectCToken pulls the account's cToken balance into the avatar.
BErc20(bTokenDebt).borrowOnAvatar(avatar, debt) creates the new debt on the avatar.
AbsBToken forwarding calls (redeem/borrow/transfer/approve) executed against the avatar with msg.sender as beneficiary.
importer.transfer(ethAmountToFlashBorrow) sends borrowed ETH to an arbitrary importer address.
FlashLoanLike(flash).borrow(ETH, amount, msg.data) re-enters a caller-supplied flash provider.
create2 assembly deployment of the avatar proxy using a salt derived from the owner address.
underlying.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, _avatar, mintAmount) pulls tokens from the caller into the avatar.
IAvatarCErc20(_avatar).mint(cToken, mintAmount) mints cTokens on the avatar.
flash.transfer(ethAmountToFlashBorrow) repays the flash provider.
flash.transfer(ethAmountToFlashBorrow + 1000) repays the provider plus a fixed extra amount.
List of collateral cTokens to move.
List of underlying assets of the collateral cTokens.
List of debt cTokens to migrate.
List of debt underlying assets.
Amount of flash-borrowed ETH that must be returned.
Compound account address derived from tx.origin.
Avatar obtained from the registry for the imported account.
Contract ETH balance used as the flash-minted amount.
Array of the account's current Compound borrow balances.
Caller-supplied Import contract address that receives loaned ETH.
Amount of ETH requested from the flash provider.
Caller-supplied flash loan provider address.
Address granted delegate permission.
New owner address for the Registry.
Arbitrary target contract for the forwarded call.
Arbitrary calldata forwarded to the target.
Amount of underlying to transfer and mint.
Owner whose avatar is resolved.

edges.reason: importAccount trusts tx.origin as the Compound account owner, so an attacker-controlled contract call can import a phishing victim's account.
importCollateral derives the imported account from tx.origin without an explicit owner authorization.
importAccount resolves (and may create) the avatar of tx.origin through the registry.
importCollateral resolves the avatar of the tx.origin account.
The whole contract ETH balance is captured as the amount to flash-mint.
The captured ETH balance is minted onto the avatar through bETH.
bETH state variable supplies the BToken used for the mint.
importAccount first re-creates the debt on B before touching Compound.
importAccount then repays the original Compound debt.
importAccount finally moves the collateral into B.
Repayment amounts are passed into Compound repayBorrowBehalf calls.
The account's collateral balance is pushed into the avatar via collectCToken.
The cToken to bToken mapping is consulted before entering the market.
The re-created debt amount is borrowed on the avatar through the BToken.
c2b is used to resolve the bToken for each debt cToken.
The flash-minted ETH is redeemed back from B at the end of the import.
Any shortfall versus the flash loan is borrowed on the avatar.
The remaining ETH balance is swept to the caller at the end of importAccount.
msg.sender is the recipient of the swept ETH balance.
The payable fallback allows ETH reimbursements to be received during the import flow.
flashImport forwards the flash-borrowed ETH to the supplied importer.
The importer address, fully controlled by the caller, is the transfer recipient.
When the balance is insufficient flashImport re-enters the caller-supplied flash provider with identical msg.data.
flashImport calls Import(importer).importAccount on an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
The flash provider calls back into flashImport before the original frame finishes, allowing state to be observed mid-flow.
After the import, flashImport repays the flash provider.
The caller controls the amount that is borrowed and forwarded.
The flash provider address is fully caller-supplied, so an attacker chooses the re-entering contract.
flashImport has no access control; any caller can drive it with an arbitrary importer and provider.
The fees variant forwards the flash-borrowed ETH to the caller-supplied importer.
The importer parameter is the transfer recipient.
flashImport recursively calls the caller-supplied flash provider when the balance is short.
The fees variant invokes Import(importer).importAccount on an attacker-chosen contract.
The flash provider re-enters flashImport, re-processing msg.data before repayment.
The provider is repaid the borrowed amount plus a hard-coded 1000 wei.
The fees variant is likewise permissionless and accepts an arbitrary importer and provider.
delegateAndExecuteOnce keys everything on msg.sender but then grants a delegate and performs an arbitrary external call.
The caller's avatar is created/obtained before delegating.
A delegatee is granted permission before the arbitrary call.
The arbitrary call is routed through the DummyCaller helper.
DummyCaller.execute performs the low-level call with value on the caller-chosen target.
The arbitrary external call runs while the temporary delegate permission is still active, letting the target re-enter the Registry.
delegateAvatar writes delegate[_avatar][delegatee] = true, the sole authorization state for on-avatar operations.
delegateAvatar resolves the caller's avatar from msg.sender before granting the delegate.
avatarOf[msg.sender] is read to identify the avatar being delegated.
getAvatar lazily deploys a new avatar when none exists.
_newAvatar deploys the proxy through _deployAvatarProxy.
avatarOf[_owner] is written after deployment.
ownerOf[_avatar] is written to bind the proxy to its owner.
The proxy bytecode and implementation address are used in a CREATE2 deployment.
avatarImpl supplies the logic contract address embedded in the proxy.
The owner parameter drives the avatar lookup in getAvatar.
onlyDelegatee uses msg.sender as the assumed delegatee for on-avatar BToken operations.
The modifier consults registry.delegate(_avatar, msg.sender) as its only authorization check.
The registry reference is used to perform the delegatee check.
AbsBToken._myAvatar resolves the caller's avatar through registry.getAvatar.
The mint amount is transferred from the caller to the avatar as underlying.
msg.sender is the funding source of the underlying transfer.
After funding, the mint amount is passed to the avatar's CErc20 mint.
The wrapped cToken address is used as the mint target.
BEther.mint forwards msg.value to the avatar CEther mint.
The registry-resolved avatar address receives the forwarded redeem/borrow/transfer calls.
Delegatee-gated entrypoints forward avatar calls while the underlying authorization lives only in Registry.delegate.
newBToken records c2b[cToken] = bToken after deploying the wrapper.
The proxy fallback delegatecalls the master copy with the raw calldata.
delegatecall leaves the implementation in charge of the proxy's storage and any subsequent calls.
masterCopy is loaded from storage slot 0 and used as the delegatecall target.
transferOwnership rewrites the owner state that guards all onlyOwner Registry setters.
The onlyOwner modifier compares _msgSender() against the stored owner.

normalization_plan.reason: Input list only feeds the collateral migration flow of importAccount.
Length-checked input list used only for the import validation.
Debt cToken list consumed directly by importAccount's debt migration.
Debt underlying list consumed directly by importAccount.
Flash loan amount governs the final repayment branch of importAccount.
Account derived from tx.origin inside importAccount.
Avatar resolved inside importAccount and used in its unsafe calls.
Balance amount is the value minted onto the avatar through bETH.
Debt array drives the borrow-on-B call sequence.
Caller-supplied importer contract governs the flashImport callbacks.
Amount parameter determines the forwarded and repaid value.
Provider address controls where the recursive borrow call is sent.
Delegatee address is written into the delegate authorization mapping.
New owner address written into the _owner state variable.
Target address is the destination of the arbitrary low-level call.
Calldata is forwarded verbatim into the arbitrary low-level call.
Amount pulled from the caller and minted on the avatar.
Owner address keying the avatarOf lookup and lazy avatar creation.
